fieldData.description: To celebrate the 1 year anniversary of Radix mainnet launch, the Radix community in Amsterdam is organising its first meetup event, with many more to come! Make sure to stop by and have a casual chat about crypto, DeFi, and RadixDLT. It’ll be a fun, welcoming event with free food and drinks.
fieldData.location: Het Sieraad BV., Amsterdam 1 Postjesweg 1057 DT Amsterdam Netherlands
fieldData.name: Radix Community Meetup - Amsterdam
